name: 07716 · Atlantic Hlds, NJ
findings: ZIP 07716 (Atlantic Hlds) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07716 (Atlantic Hlds) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
